terms.term_amharic: የ SI ዩኒቶች (SI Units) እና ኮንቨርዥን (ምዕራፍ 1)
terms.definition: SI Units and Conversions is a core topic in Grade 9 Physics covering essential principles on pages 1-35.
terms.definition_amharic: የ SI ዩኒቶች (SI Units) እና ኮንቨርዥን በ9ኛ ክፍል ፊዚክስ (Physics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 1-35 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

terms.definition: Velocity and Acceleration is a core topic in Grade 9 Physics covering essential principles on pages 1-35.
terms.definition_amharic: ቪሎሲቲ (Velocity) እና አክሰለሬሽን (Acceleration) በ9ኛ ክፍል ፊዚክስ (Physics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 1-35 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

terms.term_amharic: የኒውተን የሞሽን ሕጎች (Newton's Laws of Motion) (ምዕራፍ 1)
terms.definition: Newton Laws of Motion is a core topic in Grade 9 Physics covering essential principles on pages 1-35.
terms.definition_amharic: የኒውተን የሞሽን ሕጎች (Newton's Laws of Motion) በ9ኛ ክፍል ፊዚክስ (Physics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 1-35 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

terms.definition: Work Energy and Power is a core topic in Grade 9 Physics covering essential principles on pages 1-35.
terms.definition_amharic: ወርክ (Work)፣ ኢነርጂ (Energy) እና ፓወር (Power) በ9ኛ ክፍል ፊዚክስ (Physics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 1-35 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

terms.definition: Fluid Density and Pressure is a core topic in Grade 9 Physics covering essential principles on pages 1-35.
terms.definition_amharic: የፍሉይድ (Fluid) ዴንሲቲ እና ፕሬሸር (Pressure) በ9ኛ ክፍል ፊዚክስ (Physics) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 1-35 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።
